description: Selective-install closure map for adlc-team-skills. npx/adlc-cli `skills add --skill X` installs exactly X; borrowers that reference a canonical helper in another skill list that skill here so installers can auto-include it (adlc-cli expands --skill from this file). Keys and values are skill directory names under skills/<group>/<skill>/ (mirror: .agents/skills/<skill>/).
